I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`, with the interval as a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant. I haven't run the test. It calls the live sandbox, and the real check is whether CI stops flaking.

0.25s keeps the test at about 4 requests per second, under the 5 per second limit. The loop makes four calls, so the sleeps add about a second to the test.

I also saved a note about the sandbox rate limit to the project's memory.
